text:
maria: Heads-up: coordinating the release announcement + Wed webinar. Need final changelog link, docs anchors for the benchmark section, and a 2-sentence methodology blurb for the blog/social card. Also confirm rollout cadence so comms match live schedule. @ajay @caroline

ajay: Rollout plan: canary 10% Tue 10:30am PT, ramp to 50% Tue 4pm, full roll Wed 11am PT if metrics OK. Ops will run the feature-flag script and post updates here.

caroline: Changelog draft live at https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/2026-03-20-delta and docs page at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-runtime-updates#benchmarks. I still need the concise methodology copy (1-2 lines) to anchor the section.

sam: For the webinar funnel: can we auto-tag registrants as "bench-rollout-2026" and route to the growth SDR queue? Need the 1-line hook for the registration confirmation email.

ajay: Feature flag: bench_runtime_q2. Ops command: ```ffctl rollout bench_runtime_q2 --steps 10,50,100 --wait 1h``` Fallback condition: if error_rate > 0.8% or p95 latency +40%. Ops will note timestamps.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary 10% started 1824501600 — bench_runtime_q2 active for 10% traffic.

elaine: Monitoring: added ephemeral SLO checks and a dashboard panel: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/bench-rollout. Alert if errors spike >0.5% for 5m.

maria: For messaging: highlight ~30% average unit-cost reduction and ~10ms median latency improvement. Ajay, can we standardize on numbers for the press copy?

ajay: From internal runs: unit cost reduction 27-33% depending on sequence length, median latency ~-9ms; p95 shows improvement ~-20ms in most configs. I'll provide 2-line methodology and a single-sentence caveat.

ajay: Suggested methodology line: "Measurements combine 60k synthetic requests plus 15k anonymized production traces (median seq length: 128 tokens)." Suggested caveat: "Results vary by model and request distribution."

caroline: Inserted ajay's text into the docs anchor and updated the changelog link in the page. Pushed final doc URLs to the shared drive.

sam: Registration email hook: "Join our webinar to see how the new runtime cuts inference cost by ~30% while improving latency — live demos and benchmark walkthroughs." Route tag confirmed to growth SDR queue.

maria: Final checklist: - pin changelog link in #marketing - upload final slide deck and benchmark assets to comms folder - confirm webinar landing uses the exact phrasing above. Please drop assets by EOD Monday.

ajay: Will post here when ramp hits 50% and again after full roll.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Ramp to 50% successful 1824501850 — no error spike observed.

elaine: 50% steady. No alerts. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks team — this helps. I'll draft the announcement with the links + slide deck and tag for review.
